abstract: Over a thirteen year period forty patients underwent surgery to remove an orbital dermoid cyst. Cysts which became manifest after the age of three years were deeper and larger than most that were noted before that age. Three out of four epidermoid cysts appeared after the age of 17 years and had an intracranial component. The majority of cysts showed histological evidence of leakage and associated inflammation. It is our view that dermoid cysts should be totally excised because they gradually enlarge and cause inflammation and scarring in adjacent structures.
abstract_ja: 13年間に眼窩類皮嚢腫の摘出術を受けた患者40例を検討した。3歳以降に発見された嚢腫は、それ以前に発見されたものより深部にあり、大きかった。17歳以降に出現した類表皮嚢腫4例中3例は頭蓋内成分を伴っていた。大半の嚢腫は組織学的に漏出と炎症を示した。嚢腫は徐々に増大し、周囲構造に炎症と瘢痕を生じるため、完全切除すべきであるという見解を示している。
